mcp.note: REAL, not a scaffold — this repo IS an MCP bridge: a Figma plugin (manifest.json, editorType figma/figjam) talking to a localhost MCP server over bridge-server.js. Outstanding for mcp-maintainer: (1) no tools.json declaring the surface or `mutates` per tool — the plugin protocol in code.js handles start-server/stop-server/mcp-request/client-connect/client-disconnect/get-server-status/ping, which is transport, not a tool manifest; (2) mcp-server-config.json hardcodes an absolute Windows cwd (C:/Users/izzyw/source/FuzeX) so the config is not portable to any other machine or to CI.

portal.reason: FuzeX is a Figma/FigJam plugin, not a web app. Its UI runs in Figma's plugin sandbox (manifest.json: editorType [figma, figjam], ui.html) and networkAccess is deliberately restricted to localhost — there is no served origin to iframe and no remoteEntry to federate. Registering it in the FuzeFront portal would add a side-menu entry that cannot mount anything.
